title: Native link with a library compiled again after its client: uncaught Consistbl.Inconsistency
summary: When a library is compiled again after a client was compiled against it, `ocamlopt` refuses the link, as it must, but with an uncaught exception, `Consistbl.Make(...).Inconsistency`, in place of the "make inconsistent assumptions over implementation" error.

expected.text: The link fails with `Error: Files test.cmx and lib.cmx make inconsistent assumptions over implementation Lib`.
expected.output: make inconsistent assumptions over implementation Lib

actual.text: The link fails with `Fatal error: exception Consistbl.Make(Module_name)(Data).Inconsistency("Lib", "lib.cmx", "test.cmx", 0, 0)`.

cause: `check_consistency` in the native linker checks a unit's own digest against what earlier units said of it outside the handler that turns `Inconsistency` into an error; the client is read first, so the library's own check is the one that fails.
